securities_disclosures.name: SEC 8-K Material Cybersecurity Incident Monitor
securities_disclosures.notes: Open-source monitor for SEC 8-K cybersecurity incident disclosures. Use the SEC's own EDGAR filing data as the authoritative underlying document and extract Item 1.05 filings for candidate review.

securities_disclosures.name: SEC EDGAR Company Filings API
securities_disclosures.notes: Official SEC company-submissions endpoint; use it with a declared User-Agent and identify Item 1.05 8-K filings for material cybersecurity incidents.

cert_and_psirt_sources.name: CISA Cybersecurity Advisories
cert_and_psirt_sources.notes: Official consolidated CISA cybersecurity advisory feed; retained as a direct canonical endpoint alongside existing CISA source entries.

implementation_notes: SEC disclosures must be attributed to the filing entity and linked to the specific primary filing before publication.
Regulatory enforcement notices and vendor research identify candidates only; they do not establish that an age-verification provider or its user data were affected.
Deduplicate canonical CISA and NCSC URLs against prior source lists before scheduling polling.
